sources.selection_rationale: Lowest officially documented, reproducible ESP-IDF TX-power step; intentionally weak so RSSI-based Home confirmation over the small Nest corresponds to genuinely close range. Configurable in both simulation and real firmware via the same esp_wifi_set_max_tx_power(8) call.

sources.selection_rationale: Common, non-edge, ESP32-supported 2.4 GHz channel (2437 MHz); explicitly configurable via BEACON_WIFI_CHANNEL, not hardcoded independently of channel.
The datasheet does not publish a value directly usable as a scalar antenna gain in the link-budget equation; a neutral 0 dBi is used rather than an invented measured figure, pending calibration.
